import math
import unittest
from solution import locate_plateaus


class LocatePlateausTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_finds_and_sorts_qualifying_cells(self):
        matrix = [
            [9, 1, 9.0],
            [2, 8, 3],
            [7, 0, 6],
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            locate_plateaus(matrix, 6),
            [
                {"row": 0, "column": 0, "value": 9},
                {"row": 0, "column": 2, "value": 9.0},
                {"row": 1, "column": 1, "value": 8},
                {"row": 2, "column": 0, "value": 7},
                {"row": 2, "column": 2, "value": 6},
            ],
        )
        self.assertIs(type(locate_plateaus(matrix, 6)[0]["value"]), int)
        self.assertIs(type(locate_plateaus(matrix, 6)[1]["value"]), float)

    def test_strict_neighbor_rule_and_cutoff(self):
        self.assertEqual(locate_plateaus([[5, 5]], 5), [])
        self.assertEqual(locate_plateaus([[4]], 5), [])
        self.assertEqual(locate_plateaus([[5]], 5), [{"row": 0, "column": 0, "value": 5}])
        self.assertEqual(locate_plateaus([], 0), [])

    def test_does_not_mutate_matrix(self):
        matrix = [[1, 3], [2, 0]]
        before = [row[:] for row in matrix]
        locate_plateaus(matrix, 1)
        self.assertEqual(matrix, before)

    def test_rejects_malformed_inputs(self):
        cases = [
            (None, 0),
            ([[]], 0),
            ([[1, 2], [3]], 0),
            ([[1], "row"], 0),
            ([[True]], 0),
            ([["1"]], 0),
            ([[math.inf]], 0),
            ([[math.nan]], 0),
            ([[1]], True),
            ([[1]], "0"),
            ([[1]], math.inf),
            ([[1]], math.nan),
        ]
        for matrix, cutoff in cases:
            with self.subTest(matrix=matrix, cutoff=cutoff):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    locate_plateaus(matrix, cutoff)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
